change: V7 Parallel DATA, FRONTIER, and extent-preparation handles are buffered clones of the same verified inode/open file description. The existing ticket/packing/io_uring/completion pipeline remains. Earlier formats keep O_DIRECT. Keep existing extent initialization and framing unchanged so this isolates the backend change.
correctness: Require concurrent later-DATA/unsynced-FRONTIER preservation/recovery test, existing short-marker and failed-sync poisoning tests, and full cargo make check before benchmark. Buffered write CQEs are not durability; no ACK until the one inode fdatasync succeeds.
common: 1 KiB values; 2 GiB SST target; sample every 10 batches or 100 point operations. Four unscored warmups per cell. Four-arm pairs old_v4,new_v4,old_v7,new_v7 when odd; reverse when even. No tests/builds/profiles overlap scored runs.
cooldown: SSD: initial 30 seconds, 10 seconds between every run. Tmpfs: three seconds between runs.

ssd_gate.material_gain: At least one SSD cell must achieve >=1.02 paired raw throughput and >=1.00 v4-normalized throughput.

conditional_ram: Only if the SSD gate passes: all three RAM cells. Require paired raw and normalized throughput plus ratio of per-arm median rates >=0.95; CPU <=1.05; solo p99 <=1.10.
conditional_confirmation: Only if SSD and RAM gates pass: exactly five additional pairs per SSD cell, same protocol plus four warmups each. Pool ten pairs per SSD cell; SSD gates must still pass. No further attempts selected by results.
on_failure: Cancel dependent phases; preserve every failed capture and exact candidate patch/source manifest. Restore retained source and canonical executable, refresh source mtimes, and run fresh required checks.
interpretation: This is distinct from the rejected mixed buffered-FRONTIER/direct-DATA prototype. Kernel writeback may combine adjacent dirty DATA and FRONTIER frames. Do not pool the two different candidates. Keep the same baseline and numerical gates. Physical writeback/page-cache costs may increase; marker timing alone is insufficient.
